title: Cancelling Superseded Runs
description: A concurrency group with cancel-in-progress turned on, so a newer push cancels an older CI run that is already obsolete.

steps.description: This is a `concurrency` group. It controls how runs that share a key overlap.
`group: ci-${{ github.ref }}` builds the key from the branch reference, so runs on the same branch share one group.

`cancel-in-progress: true` stops the older run when a newer push arrives. The comment says the newer push cancels the older, still-running CI, so you are not paying for a build that is already obsolete.

steps.question: The page says to keep `cancel-in-progress` set to which value for the deploy job, so a live deploy is never interrupted mid-flight?
